info.name: Leave Policy Management APIs
info.description:
Comprehensive Leave Policy APIs including Multi-Leave Entitlements (CL, SL, EL) and Role/Employee Assignments.

Base path: `/leave-policies`

item.name: 1. UI Helper: Get Roles Summary (Role Assignment Table)

request.description: Fetches all roles (Teacher, Admin, HR, Accountant, etc.) with total employees count, current policy assignment summary, and assignment mode for rendering the 'ROLE ASSIGNMENT' table in Create Leave Policy UI.

item.name: 2. UI Helper: Get Role Employees (Select Employees Drawer)

query.description: Optional: ID of current policy being edited to mark isSelected
Optional: Filter employees by name or employee code

request.description: Fetches all employees belonging to a specific roleId (e.g. Teacher = 12) for the right side drawer. Returns total count, selected count, and list of employees with current policy status.

item.name: 3. Create Leave Policy (Full Payload with Entitlements & Roles)

body.raw:
{
  "policyName": "Teaching Staff Leave Policy",
  "policyCode": "LPS-001",
  "leaveYearType": "Academic Year (Jul - Jun)",
  "description": "Leave entitlement and rules for all teaching staff.",
  "effectiveFrom": "2026-07-01",
  "effectiveTo": null,
  "status": "Published",
  "leaveEntitlements": [
    {
      "leaveType": "Casual Leave (CL)",
      "leaveCode": "CL",
      "entitlementAnnual": 12,
      "creditMethod": "Monthly",
      "carryForward": true,
      "maxCarryForwardDays": 6,
      "maximumConsecutiveDays": 3,
      "keyRules": [
        "Probation",
        "Notice",
        "Half-day"
      ],
      "status": "Configured"
    },
    {
      "leaveType": "Sick Leave (SL)",
      "leaveCode": "SL",
      "entitlementAnnual": 10,
      "creditMethod": "Monthly",
      "carryForward": true,
      "maxCarryForwardDays": 10,
      "maximumConsecutiveDays": 5,
      "keyRules": [
        "Notice",
        "Document Required",
        "Max Limit"
      ],
      "status": "Configured"
    },
    {
      "leaveType": "Earned Leave (EL)",
      "leaveCode": "EL",
      "entitlementAnnual": 15,
      "creditMethod": "Monthly",
      "carryForward": true,
      "maxCarryForwardDays": 30,
      "keyRules": [
        "Encashment",
        "Carry Forward",
        "Min/Max"
      ],
      "status": "Configured"
    }
  ],
  "roleAssignments": [
    {
      "roleId": 12,
      "assignmentMode": "SELECTED",
      "effectiveFrom": "2026-07-01",
      "selectedUserIds": [46, 47, 48]
    },
    {
      "roleId": 14,
      "assignmentMode": "ALL",
      "effectiveFrom": "2026-07-01",
      "selectedUserIds": []
    }
  ]
}

request.description:
Creates a complete Leave Policy in a single atomic transaction:
1. Main policy details (Name, Code, Leave Year, Effective Dates, Status: Draft/Published)
2. Child table `leave_policy_entitlements` (CL, SL, EL with rules)
3. Child table `leave_policy_roles` (Role assignments with ALL or SELECTED mode)
4. Child table `leave_policy_employees` (Explicitly selected user IDs for SELECTED mode)
5. If status is 'Published', automatically initializes leave_balance for assigned employees.

item.name: 4. Get Leave Policies (Filtered by Role / Hybrid)

query.description: Optional: Filter by specific role ID. If omitted, defaults to logged-in user's role.
Optional: Set true for Admin to view all policies across all roles.
Optional: Set true to view all policies of the role ignoring individual employee selection.

request.description: Fetches leave policies assigned to a role. Automatically applies hybrid filter (assignment_mode = ALL OR user exists in selectedEmployees). If all=true, returns unfiltered list for Admin.

item.name: 5. Get Single Leave Policy by ID

request.description: Returns full details of a specific policy along with its entitlements (CL, SL, EL), role assignments, and selected employees.

item.name: 6. Get My Active Policies (For Logged-in User)

request.description: Returns active leave policies accessible to the logged-in user.
Updates master leave policy fields (e.g. changing status from Draft to Published, updating description or dates).
